article.title: Why the U.S. can’t stop arming Israel
article.author: Sana Saeed
article.content: In episode two of The Necessary State, Sana Saeed traces how Israel was built into the American military and security infrastructure, and how U.S. weapons makers profit from a cycle in which taxpayer money buys the arms, the arms are used, and the stockpiles are refilled.
